description: Returns all configured notification channels (Slack, ntfy, Discord, email, webhooks, etc.). To attach a channel to a monitor you only need its id — the credentials in `config` are withheld by default and the names of the withheld fields are listed in `redactedConfigKeys`.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***". Off by default: this output is persisted in conversation transcripts and logs. Can also be enabled globally with UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS=true.

name: listNotifications

notifications.description: Array of notification channel configurations. By default `config` is reduced to its non-secret fields and `redactedConfigKeys` names what was withheld.

applyExisting.description: Apply this notification to all existing monitors

isDefault.description: Whether this notification is enabled by default for new monitors

name.description: Human-readable name for this notification channel

type.description: Notification type (e.g. slack, ntfy, discord, telegram, email, webhook)

title: List Notifications
